text:
Noise misses by only 0.7%, and every other spec passes with margin. The sensitivities point to a simple fix: raise the diff pair's gm/Id and add a little L1 and Lp. This increases gate area, which cuts 1/f noise. It also lowers Vgs1, which gives the tail transistor M5 more headroom (it has only 84 mV of Vds above Vdsat now).

Phase margin is the risk, since the larger pair adds parasitic capacitance. There is about 6.7° of margin, so I keep Cc and the compensation parameters near their current values.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Noise misses by 0.7%; others pass. Raise gmid1 and L1 (strongest noise levers, also relieve tail headroom), and slightly raise Lp. Keep compensation near current to protect the 6.7 deg PM margin.",
 "params": {"gmid1": 21.5, "L1": 4.5, "Itail": 50e-6, "gmid3": 6.5, "Lp": 1.8, "Cc": 3e-12, "p2k": 4.0, "rzk": 1.3, "gmidb": 11.0, "Lb": 1.0},
 "bounds": {"gmid1": [19.0, 24.0], "L1": [3.5, 6.0], "Itail": [40e-6, 80e-6], "Lp": [1.2, 3.0], "Cc": [2.5e-12, 4e-12], "p2k": [3.5, 6.0], "rzk": [1.0, 2.0]}}
```
